title: Death of Bilgames: Ziusudra the last to be given immortality

tellings.quote: there's an obscure tablet called the death of billig games and it is a tablet and bames is another name for Gilgamesh and you find out in that that these anuna Gods had given the Noah figure Zas sudra the he was the last man ever to get immortality

plain: An old Mesopotamian clay tablet called The Death of Bilgames (Bilgames being another name for Gilgamesh) says the Anunna gods gave the flood hero Ziusudra, the Noah figure of the story, immortality, and that he was the last man ever to receive it. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this on the show as something he has read, calling it an 'obscure tablet'. He reads it as a sign that the gods stopped granting immortality after the flood. In the story as he gives it, the flood survivor is made immortal and nobody else is after him, much as Noah's story comes after a flood.
